description: Erection of single storey side extension (Retrospective)
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The existing use of materials on the external
surfaces of the extension, as constructed, would be detrimental to the
character and appearance of the dwelling and adversely affect the visual
amenities of the streetscene and sets a dangerous precedent. As such, this element of the proposal, as
submitted/built falls contrary to guidance prescribed under the ‘National
Planning Policy Framework’ (2024), Policy D3 (D.(1) and (11)) of The London
Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM1
and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), Policies GR1 and GR2 of Harrow
Draft Development Management Policies Local Plan (2024) and guidance contained within the
Councils adopted Supplementary Planning Document: entitled ‘Residential Design’
(2010).</p>

The proposal, by reason of its
design, in particular the siting, scale and fenestration of the window at the front of the property fails to harmonise well with those seen on
the main dwellinghouse as well as adjoining and nearby neighbouring properties
and falls at odds, failing to compliment or enhance the character and
appearance of the host dwelling or that that of the public realm contrary to
guidance prescribed under the ‘National Planning Policy Framework’ (2024),
Policy D3 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1.B of the Harrow Core
Strategy (2012), Policies DM1 and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management
Policies Local Plan (2013), Policies GR1 and GR2 of the Harrow Draft
Development Management Policies Local Plan (2024) and guidance contained within
the Councils adopted Supplementary Planning Document: entitled ‘Residential
Design’ (2010).
